name: ScrollVelocity

requirements: The text is ordinary text in the page from the server render, readable with no JavaScript, and read once by screen readers
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
Moving content can be stopped: by isPaused, by the Pause button, and by anything inside rdm-still
Only the first copy of each row is in the accessibility tree; repeats are aria-hidden
Reduced motion gives static rows that can be scrolled by hand, with the repeats removed
screenReader: Each row is read once as ordinary text

description: Rows of large text that drift sideways, speeding up and reversing with how fast the page is scrolled. Rows alternate direction.

speed.description: Resting speed in pixels per second.

velocityFactor.description: How strongly page scrolling adds to the speed. 0 ignores scrolling.

showPauseButton.description: Shows a visible Pause and Play button (WCAG 2.2.2).

pauseLabel.description: Text of the button while moving.

playLabel.description: Text of the button while paused.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the text plainly. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

use_when: Large decorative words between page sections
anti_patterns: Essential information in a moving row
